serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It seems like my soup arrived first. 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: It looks tasty.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: Why aren’t you eating?
You: It’s rude to eat when everyone’s food is not served yet.
Bot: Won’t it get cold? 
Yeah, I didn't think about that when I was ordering my soup. Whatever that gnocchi is, for sure it takes longer to make.
You: Don't worry about it! It would be weird for me to start eating before you.
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: I-If you say so…
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
